_comment: Authored Dive links for the off-screen water links (water.py, world simulation spec, walker graph). Each row joins two open-water tiles that Dive and emerge connect, both directions, so the off-screen simulation can cross between the two water bodies. The on-screen walker never uses water. Sootopolis's only way out is diving through Underwater_SootopolisCity, whose warp leads to Underwater_Route126 (45, 65); emerging there surfaces on Route126 at the same tile. fly: authored land-to-land links the off-screen simulation crosses like water (the Elite Four fly between Indigo Plateau and the Victory Road reception gate, since Victory Road is one-way on foot); both directions, open to every trainer; each end is a land tile whose walkable component the link joins.
